_comment: Single-turn deterministic eval cases for the booking receptionist. Mirrors the production eval design: each case asserts which tools the model SHOULD and SHOULD NOT call, and string fragments the reply must / must not contain. No LLM-as-judge by design — deterministic checks only, to avoid eval theater. To run against the real model you would feed each `user` message through the agent with a fresh session and assert on the tool-call trace + reply text (a runner is left as an exercise; the harness shape is intentionally simple).
